title: Assisted Living Late Fee Amount and the Past-Due Amount of a Billing Period
content:
**Billing period.** The billing period of an Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement late fee is the billing month most recently billed in full, that is the billing month of the most recent full-month rent charge on the residency, running from its first day to its last day; the posting date of the monthly charges is the posting date of that rent charge.

**Past-due amount.** The past-due amount of the late fee is the rent, full-month care fee and monthly add-on charges of the billing period, the monthly add-ons being those whose service date is the first day of the billing month, less every credit that carries the billing period and less the payments posted less than one whole month before the handling date. The past-due amount is never below zero. A payment counts as posted less than one whole month before the handling date when the count from its posting date to the handling date has not yet reached the same day of the following month: with a handling date of 20 May, a payment posted on 21 April counts and one posted on 20 April does not.

**Late fee.** The late fee is the greater of the flat late fee and the late fee percentage of the past-due amount, rounded once to the cent half up at the end, and none is assessed when the past-due amount is below the minimum past-due amount. The flat late fee, the late fee percentage and the minimum past-due amount are those of the resident account terms.

### Worked figures (hypothetical ledger; account terms of 85.00 flat, 1.5 percent and a 150.00 minimum)

| Charges of the billing period | Credits carrying the period | Payments in the last whole month | Past-due amount | Late fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Rent 4285.00, full-month care fee 1874.00, insulin management 465.00 dated the 1st | 0.00 | 0.00 | 6624.00 | 1.5 percent of 6624.00 is 99.36, greater than 85.00: 99.36 |
| Same charges | 0.00 | 3624.00 | 3000.00 | 1.5 percent is 45.00; the greater is 85.00 |
| Same charges | 906.77 | 5567.23 | 150.00 | Not below the minimum; 1.5 percent is 2.25; the greater is 85.00 |
| Same charges | 906.77 | 5567.24 | 149.99 | Below the minimum: none assessed |

A per-use charge such as a tray or a bath assist dated after the first day of the month is not a monthly add-on and is not part of the past-due amount.
